title: Beartooth · Red Lodge to Cooke City
slogan: A 156 km loop out of Beartooth Pass
story: Alpine lakes, high altitude and an official status check before coffee. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then ride Beartooth Pass with something in reserve. The best part sits around Beartooth Pass, Yellowstone northeast gate, while Cooke City and Top of the World store keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.
